pages.text: Platform Operations Runbook. The platform team owns service health, incident response, deployment safety, and API reliability for the production application.
Incident response targets. Severity 1 incidents require an RTO of 4 hours and an RPO of 15 minutes. The incident commander must post updates every 30 minutes.
Deployment and rollback. Standard production deployments use canary release. If the error budget burn rate exceeds threshold, rollback must complete within 10 minutes.
API reliability. Public API clients are limited to 120 requests per minute per tenant. Burst traffic above the quota receives HTTP 429 responses.
Observability. Logs are retained for 30 days in the hot store. Metrics are retained for 13 months. Trace samples are retained for 14 days.

pages.text: Customer Support Policy. This policy describes refund windows, support escalation, account deletion, and backup retention for customer-facing operations.
Refunds. Self-service subscriptions may be refunded within 14 days of purchase if usage remains below the monthly included quota.
Enterprise escalation. Enterprise severity 1 support tickets receive a first human response within 2 hours and are reviewed by the duty manager.
Account deletion. Verified deletion requests are completed within 30 days. Customer backups that contain deleted account data expire within 90 days.
Data exports. Customers can request a JSON export of account configuration, billing contacts, and audit log metadata.

pages.text: Security Administration Handbook. The security team defines identity federation, privileged access review, data residency, and encryption key operations.
Enterprise identity federation uses SAML 2.0 assertions. OIDC is supported only for workforce pilot tenants.
Privileged access reviews occur quarterly. Standard user access reviews occur every 180 days.
EU regulated workloads must be pinned to the Frankfurt region. Analytics replicas remain disabled for those tenants.
Customer-managed encryption keys rotate every 365 days. Provider-managed keys rotate every 90 days.

pages.text: Integration Engineering Manual. The integration team maintains delivery retries, catalog synchronization, audit exports, and sandbox limits.
Retry keys remain valid for 24 hours. Duplicate delivery attempts using the same key are ignored during that window.
Delta sync jobs run every 15 minutes. Full reindex jobs run nightly at 02:00 UTC.
The audit export includes actor, action, object, timestamp, and request_id fields.
Sandbox tenants may create 25 API tokens. Production tenants may create 100 API tokens.

pages.text: Compliance Service Matrix. The compliance team publishes service commitments, data portability rules, audit evidence, and incident communication standards.
The monthly uptime objective is 99.95% for covered production services.
Download bundles expire after 72 hours. Expired bundles must be generated again by the customer.
Evidence packages include SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certificates.
Production incident postmortems must be published within five business days after resolution.
